facts.value: In Frankfurt, the programme is divided into three main focuses: American Literature and Literary Studies, American Culture and Cultural Studies, and American History and Society.

The American Studies department at IEAS is one of the few interdisciplinary American Studies departments in Germany. This orientation is reinforced by close cooperation with other institutes at Goethe University.

Due to the research interests of professors and staff, specific focuses in teaching include certain literary epochs or specific literary and media forms, approaches such as African-American Studies, Gender and Queer Studies, Animal Studies, Film Studies, Sound Studies, Media Philosophy, Aesthetics of Democracy, or the history of the Civil Rights Movement.
From the 3rd semester onwards, students specialize in two of the three offered focuses and begin to develop their own profile.
